text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Liamine Zeroual calls on political party leaders who stayed away from national conference to join in a signed pact in order to broaden the "ranks of Algeria's builders" after nearly five years of bloodshed blamed on Moslem radicals.
- Amar Tou, a National Liberation Front (FLN) leader, says national conference was a stage bringing Algeria from a transitional situation into stability.
- General elections to complete rebuilding of Algeria's institutional structures will be held next year. A referendum to amend the constitution is planned for this year.
- The national conference adopted a code of conduct to ensure healthy political practices.
- Local authorities handed over three million young plants to tree growers in Batna province.
